what: Amrize is a North American building materials company separated from Holcim. It sells cement, aggregates, ready-mixed concrete, asphalt and roofing systems, covering a building from foundation to roof.
customers: Infrastructure and commercial contractors, roofing contractors, housebuilders and state transport agencies.
money: cement, aggregates, ready-mixed concrete and asphalt
moat: Cement plants and quarries close to the markets they serve, where transport cost protects each site, combined with a roofing business that sells through contractor networks.
risks: Residential construction is weak while mortgage rates are high
Revenue grew only about 1% last year
Debt of about $5.6 billion against almost no cash
It is newly independent with a short record as a standalone company
opportunities: Operating margin of 16% with roofing earning well above the materials average
US infrastructure funding supports multi-year road and bridge demand
Data centre and manufacturing construction consumes large volumes of concrete
watch: Building Envelope margin and aggregates pricing.
